sec3.manual: Pull by hand in a power cut
container.container: Many ways to control your curtains, with no effort
container.title:
Phone or remote:
one touch is enough
container.txt: Besides voice control, you can open or close the curtains from afar with one touch in the phone app or on the remote (up to 30 m away).
container.title2:
Touch to start,
glides all the way
container.txt2: Give the curtain a gentle pull and the motor starts on its own. In a power cut, you can still pull it by hand with ease.
container.title3: Smart sensing: it stops when blocked
container.txt3: If the curtain meets strong resistance while it opens or closes, the motor stops, which protects it and extends its life.
container.container2: It remembers its stops, and your little habits
container.container3: It learns the width of the window by itself, so there are no travel limits to set by hand and setup takes less time. Precise, flexible limits let it stop half open, fully open, a quarter open and more.
block1.container: Born powerful, thanks to ORVIBO Home
block1.container2: The smart curtain works with ORVIBO Home, where you can combine it freely with nearly a hundred smart products to build your own scenes.
block2.container2: Check the lithium battery’s charge in the ORVIBO Home app at any time, and swap in the spare in time to keep the curtain running.
sec9.sec9: Small size, big torque: fits classic curtain boxes
sec9.sec92: Its compact design takes up little room, so even a classic 12 cm curtain box easily fits a double track. The high-precision DC motor has strong torque and pulls curtains of up to 50 kg.
note.lab: * Lab data. Actual results may vary slightly with the measuring method.
sec10.sec10: Two ways to power it: no outlet needed to install
sec10.sec102: It runs on mains power or on a lithium battery. If you planned an outlet before decorating, simply plug it in; if not, use the lithium battery that comes with the motor, which lasts 6 months on a charge.
fix.fix2: The high-precision DC motor draws little power, never overheats and runs at under 30 dB, as quiet as a whisper. The track is built to be ultra quiet and ultra smooth, and its toothed-belt drive is easier to install and lasts longer.
